text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear paragraphing with \"First,\" \"Second,\" \"Finally,\"","quality":"organization","description":"The essay uses a recognizable structure with distinct paragraphs and transitional markers that make its argument easier to follow."},{"evidence":"longer sentences joined with connectors like \"because,\" \"and,\" \"if,\" \"after\"","quality":"syntactic control","description":"The essay shows more control over sentence building by combining ideas into more extended, connected statements."},{"evidence":"\"I have a good grades,\" \"I am interesting about business,\" \"I don't use my phone during class\"","quality":"sentence completeness","description":"The essay more often produces complete, readable clauses and avoids the heavier fragmentation seen in the other essay."},{"evidence":"\"I pay attention in class I do my homework every day\" and \"I always want to learn more every day\"","quality":"clarity of development","description":"The essay develops its points in a more direct, understandable way with examples that stay closer to the main idea."},{"evidence":"\"I want to learn more every day about my future job\"","quality":"word choice precision","description":"The essay uses somewhat more fitting vocabulary for school and career ideas, even when there are still errors."}]}
